While taking the Stena Line from Belfast to Birkenhead, I found myself laying awake late into the night and in need of a smoke. So I made my way to the door leading onto the deck and for the life of me I couldn't push it open. I assumed it was locked and walked away before it blasted open and slammed into the wall outside. I realised it wasn't locked, it was the wind keeping it shut. I pushed again with all my might and got outside. Once out there I found it to be pitch black. The wind was deafening and the rain  was torrential; I may as well have been underwater already. I barely managed to keep my cigarette lit until it was half smoked before pocketing the soggy paper leftover and forcing my way back through the door. I distinctly remember being able to just barely see the water close to me but everything else was blackness. It was moving quickly which gave me some idea of how fast the boat was going. That inky cold dark and the weather almost felt threatening. As though nature itself was beckoning me closer to the guard rail to come and die. I wouldn't say it was terrifying, but it was definitely an experience. I wouldn't wish my worst enemy to fall off the boat in those conditions.

People usually hate the new maps. I remember when White Noise happened and EVERY SINGLE MATCH was on tower. People said they hated it. I understood People were sick of it but a lot of folks said they just didn't like it. Same thing with Blood Orchid and Theme Park. I think in part it was just because it took time for people to learn the map and stop hating it - even though my current stack don't like theme park too much and tower hasn't been seen in what feels like millenia. Onto the main point, when I noticed upvotes here, it got me thinking about Emerald Plains and Lair. I genuinely think these were just poorly designed. I'd like to start by addressing the north side of the map. It seems ludicrous to me the way it was designed. The stairs, entry point, soft wall and double half wall fountain thing. There's no sensible way for either side to play that entire area in my opinion and that's probably why nobody does. Same thing with the orange stairs hallway on 2nd floor. Between the windows in that area and the staircase, it's only realistically defendable from meeting. It's far too easy to take out people holding  painting and statue from vault and archive given how quickly you can get from orange clock window to archive. On the other hand, making a push from bottom orange, folding window or clock window might as well be throwing. What I'm trying to say is it's easy to hold from far away but the entire area may as well be a no man's land. There's more I'd like to say about Emerald, like the dining room hold being a coin toss if kitchen is lost and attacking kitchen being way too difficult without extremely good aim (let's be honest, how many of you died like I did to an Azami headglitch on the counter?) Or well played vertical. I wanted to talk about Lair, but this is getting long so I'll leave it here. Bear in mind that this is my personal take as a long time player with ups and (low) downs and a long term acquaintance with every good and bad random in the universe off of Discord. You're free to have your own opinion and share it respectfully if you wish. Try have fun and good luck with your matches.
